{{short description|Hungarian mathematician}}
[[File:Geöcze Zoárd.jpeg|thumb|right|170px|Zoárd Geőcze]]
'''Zoárd Geőcze de Szendrő''' (1873–1916) was a [[Hungarian people|Hungarian]] mathematician famous for his ''theory of surfaces'' (Horváth 2005:219ff). He  was born on 23 August 1873 in [[Budapest, Hungary]] and died on 26 November 1916 in Budapest.
